title: The Packing List
old_caption: Packed a passport and a whole tent for a first date, then realized all you really need is one good question. Who in your life overpacks for feelings?

title: Honest to a Fault
old_caption: Sagittarius will tell you the jacket is a lot. Sagittarius will also tell you to wear it, because you look that happy in it. Tag your honest-but-sweet friend.

title: Sag's Itinerary
old_caption: Day 1: wake up. Day 2: figure it out. Turns out the real plan was saying the scary thing out loud. Planner or winger, which one are you?

title: Sag Says It First
old_caption: Said 'I like you' at the café counter. It worked. Also, three muffins. Have you ever panic-ordered after a big confession?

title: Sag Texts Back
old_caption: One careful paragraph from Scorpio. One 'yes!!' from Sag, two seconds later. Thursday is booked. Are you a fast replier or a careful drafter?

title: Sag on the Couch
old_caption: Sag on movie night: body on the couch, brain on a mountain, a ferris wheel and a hot-air balloon. Then one question brought it home. Who's your 'where are you right now?' person?

title: Sag Throws a Party
old_caption: Sag invited everyone. Cancer quietly fed all of them. Every great party has a kitchen hero, so who's yours?

title: The Honest Toast
old_caption: Never hand Sag the mic. Every toast starts like a roast and ends with someone tearing up into their cocoa. Who would you toast first?

title: Sag's Mystery Match
old_caption: The blind mystery card said homebody. Sag said adventure. A blanket fort with the whole night sky on the ceiling said both. Staying in or going out tonight?

title: Ask Sag Anything
old_caption: Ask Sag anything and the answer is probably yes. Text first? Yes. Bring snacks? Obviously. Cry on a first date? Sag's bringing tissues. What would you ask?
